title: Commutativity of the ring-sheaf pushout section square
statement: Let f:U → X be a morphism of schemes. Put A=f_*O_U, ρ:O_X → A its structure map, IA=f⁻¹A, r₀:f⁻¹O_X → O_U its adjoint structure map, and t₀=f⁻¹ρ. Let B be a commutative-ring sheaf on U, b:O_U → B and t:IA → B making a pushout of r₀ and t₀. For an open V of X put W=f⁻¹V, D=Γ(X,V), C=Γ(U,W), and δ=t_W ∘ η_{A,V}:C → B(W). Then f.app(V) followed by b_W equals f.app(V) followed by δ.

proof.text: Adjunction.homEquiv_unit gives r₀η=f.app(V). Naturality of the inverse-image unit gives t₀η=ηρ. Evaluate the sheaf pushout equation at W on η(x), substitute these two identities, and use ring-hom extensionality.
